oZOEAfwL.description:
Come Join Our Passionate Team! At Barracuda, we make the world a safer place. We believe every business deserves access to cloud-enabled, enterprise-grade security solutions that are easy to buy, deploy, and use. We protect email, networks, data, and applications with innovative solutions that grow and adapt with our customers’ journey. More than 200,000 organizations worldwide trust Barracuda to protect them — in ways they may not even know they are at risk — so they can focus on taking their business to the next level.

We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equal employment opportunity and equitable compensation regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.

Envision yourself at Barracuda

Barracuda Networks is looking for a Cloud Site Reliability Senior Engineer to join the centralized Cloud Operations team. In this role, you will help lead reliability improvements for production services, partner closely with Engineering and Operations teams, and contribute to scalable, resilient, and secure service delivery across Barracuda. The role includes a focus on Data Inspector while also encouraging shared ownership, cross-product collaboration, and knowledge sharing across SRE teams.

What you'll be working on

  • Help improve the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of production services through shared team ownership.
  • Lead and contribute to troubleshooting, incident response, RCA, and preventive improvements across cloud services and supporting platforms.
  • Partner with Engineering, Cloud Operations, and SRE teams to improve release readiness, deployment practices, and operational standards.
  • Support cloud platform improvements, automation, and resilience initiatives that reduce toil and improve service health.
  • Participate in On-Call rotation if required.
    Strengthen observability, alerting, and operational insights so teams can respond faster and improve service reliability.
  • Share knowledge, improve documentation, and help reduce product or domain silos across SRE and Cloud Operations teams.
  • Contribute to secure, compliant, and cost-conscious cloud operations across Azure, AWS, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and containerized services.

What you bring to the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent degree.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Operations, DevOps, or Platform Engineering.
  • Strong Linux/Unix command-line administration, troubleshooting, package management, and systems operations skills.
  • Experience managing production cloud infrastructure across Azure and/or AWS environments.
  • Hands-on experience operating container orchestration platforms, including AKS migrations, upgrades, and production operations.
  • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience, preferably with Terraform for provisioning and lifecycle management.
  • Automation, scripting, and AI-assisted engineering experience using Python, Bash, Go, YAML, generative AI tools, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Docker, container registries such as Azure Container Registry, and container lifecycle management.
  • Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
  • Experience operating monitoring, observability, and incident response platforms such as PagerDuty, Grafana, Prometheus, ELK/OpenSearch, New Relic, or Sensu.
  • Track record of practical problem solving, RCA, and corrective actions that improve service reliability.
  • Strong understanding of networking, the OSI model, SQL/NoSQL databases, and troubleshooting distributed systems.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, work independently, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Enthusiasm for collaborating with globally distributed teams through video conferencing, Slack, and other communication tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience contributing to large-scale AKS migrations, container platform modernization, or cloud transformation programs.
  • Proven ability to coordinate complex production releases across Engineering, Operations, and stakeholder teams.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted operations, generative AI tools, or automation use cases that improve engineering productivity.
  • Experience building reliability tooling, self-healing capabilities, or automation frameworks that reduce operational toil.
  • Relevant certifications in Azure, AWS, Terraform, container platforms, or cloud reliability engineering.

 

What you’ll get from us

A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are many opportunities for cross training and the ability to define your next career step within Barracuda. We support employees who want to explore other areas of interest.

oa9KAfwn.description:
AI Solutions Leader

 

AArete is one-of-a-kind when it comes to consulting firm culture.

  

We’re a global, innovative management and technology consulting firm, with offices in the U.S., India, and the U.K. Our name comes from the Greek word for excellence: “Areté.”  And excellence is exactly what we strive for.  

  

Our success starts with enriching and empowering our people. From robust career development planning to competitive life and wellness benefits, AArete’s “Culture of Care” takes a holistic approach to the employee experience.  

  

AAretians (our team members) are leaders at every level. You are encouraged to unlock your full potential by directly contributing to our mission and prioritizing space for personal development and fulfillment. 

 

The Role

 

We are seeking an AI Solutions Leader to lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions that solve complex business and operational challenges for AArete and our clients. This individual will combine deep technical expertise with a consulting mindset, partnering with clients and internal leaders to define business problems, identify practical AI opportunities, and take solutions from concept through production deployment.

 

This is a hands-on leadership role. The ideal candidate has personally designed, built, and deployed AI solutions in production environments and remains comfortable working directly with code, architecture, data, APIs, and engineering teams. This individual will also help shape AArete's AI capabilities, develop reusable solutions and accelerators, and identify opportunities to deliver measurable value through AI.

 

The role requires someone who can operate effectively in a dynamic consulting environment, balance multiple priorities and engagements, and communicate effectively with both executive stakeholders and technical teams.

 

Work You’ll Do

 

  • Partner with clients and AArete leaders to understand complex business and operational challenges and translate them into practical AI use cases and implementation strategies
  • Lead AI engagements from discovery and business-case development through solution architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support
  • Design, prototype, code, test, troubleshoot, and deploy AI solutions while providing technical leadership to engineering and data teams
  • Build and implement generative AI applications, agentic AI workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, conversational AI, predictive models, and intelligent automation solutions
  • Design enterprise AI architectures that integrate with existing data platforms, applications, APIs, workflows, security controls, and operating models
  • Develop implementation plans, technical requirements, resource estimates, delivery timelines, and solution architectures for AI initiatives
  • Lead model selection, prompt engineering, RAG design, model evaluation, performance optimization, guardrails, monitoring, and other activities required to deliver reliable AI solutions
  • Move AI initiatives beyond demonstrations and proofs of concept into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Diagnose and resolve technical challenges related to data quality, integration, performance, hallucinations, security, scalability, and adoption
  • Design solutions across modern cloud, data, and enterprise platforms such as Azure, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, and Salesforce
  • Establish standards and best practices for responsible AI, privacy, security, testing, monitoring, governance, and human oversight
  • Develop reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, demonstrations, frameworks, and delivery playbooks that can be leveraged across clients and engagements
  • Work directly with client executives, business leaders, architects, engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders to communicate AI opportunities, limitations, risks, costs, and tradeoffs
  • Recruit, mentor, and provide technical leadership to AI engineers, data scientists, architects, and consultants
  • Partner across AArete to identify opportunities to embed AI into client solutions, internal capabilities, and broader transformation initiatives
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, and partnerships based on their enterprise applicability and commercial potential
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

 

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in technology, software engineering, data, advanced analytics, AI/ML, consulting, or related disciplines with a Bachelor’s Degree, or 14+ years of equivalent experience
  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, or intelligent automation
  • Demonstrated recent experience personally designing, building, and deploying AI solutions into production environments
  • Experience implementing multiple AI solutions in production, with the ability to clearly articulate individual technical contributions, architecture decisions, challenges, and outcomes
  • Strong hands-on development capabilities using Python, SQL, APIs, and modern software-development practices
  • Experience building generative AI applications, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation solutions, conversational AI, predictive models, or intelligent automation solutions
  • Hands-on experience with model selection, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, monitoring, and performance optimization
  • Experience integrating AI solutions into complex enterprise environments, applications, workflows, and data platforms
  • Familiarity with enterprise AI and data platforms such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks, Snowflake, Salesforce, Microsoft Power Platform, or similar technologies
  • Understanding of cloud architecture, data engineering, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, testing, observability, and production-support requirements
  • Proven ability to move AI solutions from prototype or proof of concept into secure, scalable production environments
  • Experience working directly with business and technical stakeholders to define problems, evaluate AI use cases, develop technical approaches, and lead implementation
  • Ability to estimate implementation effort, define resource requirements, manage delivery risks, and develop practical implementation plans
  • Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business recommendations
  • Ability to operate effectively across multiple concurrent initiatives and adapt quickly to changing priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, or providing technical direction to engineers, data scientists, architects, or other technical professionals
  • Willingness to engage in direct client interaction, including travel to client locations
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship

 

Preferred Requirements

 

  • Experience working in consulting, professional services, systems integration, or another client-facing technology environment
  • Experience delivering enterprise AI solutions within healthcare, health plans, or another highly regulated industry
  • Working knowledge of healthcare payer functions such as claims, enrollment, member and provider services, care management, utilization management, payment integrity, risk adjustment, quality, or finance
  • Familiarity with healthcare data, privacy, security, compliance, and responsible-use requirements
  • Experience working with distributed or global engineering and delivery teams
  • Based in Chicago, IL, and flexible to work from our Chicago office as needed

 

Compensation & Benefits

 

  • Flexible PTO, monthly half-day refuels, volunteer time off, 10 paid holidays
  • Own Your Day flexible work policy
  • Competitive majority employer-paid benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K Match
  • Generous paid parental leave options
  • Employer paid Life Insurance, STD, LTD
  • Charitable contribution matching program
  • New client commission opportunities and referral bonus program
  • Bike share discount program

The estimated base salary range for this position is $235,000-$280,000. In addition to this base salary, individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. This range is a part of a competitive, total compensation package together with our majority employer-paid benefits, and incentive pay for eligible roles. Please note that this range is a guideline and individual total compensation may vary due to numerous factors including but not limited to experience level, certifications, and other relevant business considerations.

 

AArete will accept applications until the position is filled. The job posting will be removed once the role is no longer available. 

 

We put humans at the center of our work 

  

We’re a global management and technology consulting firm specializing in strategic profitability improvement, digital transformation, and strategy & change for clients. Our cross-industry solutions are powered by a digital-first mindset, market intelligence, and data-driven approach to deliver purposeful change, actionable insights, and guaranteed results.

  

But what sets us apart is our people. We are guided by our deeply embedded guiding principles: Excellence, Passion, Loyalty to Clients, Stewardship, Family, Community, Sustainability, and Inclusion.  

  

And we’ve been recognized as a top firm to work for by companies like Forbes, Top Workplaces Chicago Tribune, and Consulting Magazine.  

  

We’ve earned a Great Place to Work Certification™ and been named a World’s Best Management Consulting Firm by Forbes, Vault’s Top 50 Firms to Work For, Crain's Chicago Business Fast 50, Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Firms, and Consulting Magazine's Fastest Growing Firms.  

 

Learn more about our award-winning culture 

  

 

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer 

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

o30zAfwW.description:
The Opportunity

As an Enterprise Account Executive focused on Financial Services (FSI), you will take full strategic ownership of a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across the banking and insurance sectors in France. In this role, you will drive both expansion within existing accounts and the acquisition of new logos, leading complex, multi-year sales cycles (6–18 months) that align cloud and IT infrastructure solutions with critical business outcomes. Partnering closely with Systems Engineers, channel partners, and cross-functional teams, you will develop and execute strategic account plans that deliver measurable commercial value.

About the Team

You will be part of the French Enterprise Sales organization, sitting within a high-performing segment focused on large enterprise and FSI accounts based in Paris, Île-de-France. Reporting to the FSI Sales Manager, the team operates with a collaborative, high-autonomy culture centered on building strategic, high-value deals and long-term customer relationships. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–20%, balancing local account management in the region with strategic customer engagements.

Your Role

  • Own and execute the end-to-end strategy for a portfolio of named enterprise accounts in banking and insurance, driving revenue growth through account expansion and new logo acquisition.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-level business and IT executives (CIO, CTO, Infrastructure Leaders), positioning infrastructure and cloud platform value in the context of FSI priorities and regulatory considerations.

  • Develop and execute detailed 3-year territory strategies and account plans, leading complex sales cycles (6–18 months) from deal structuring and RFPs to contract execution.

  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams—including Presales, Specialists, Renewals, and Leadership—and engage the partner ecosystem (resellers, system integrators, cloud providers) to maximize deal velocity and indirect revenue.

  • Maintain pipeline discipline and accurate forecasting using Salesforce CRM and AVISO while providing structured customer feedback to influence product and go-to-market strategies.

What You Will Bring

  • 10+ years of enterprise sales experience with a proven track record of managing large, complex accounts and closing high-value, multi-year deals.

  • Deep domain expertise in Financial Services (banking and insurance), with a strong understanding of industry dynamics, regulatory requirements, and business priorities.

  • Demonstrated experience selling complex IT solutions, including infrastructure, cloud platforms, SaaS, or software solutions.

  • Proven success in both acquiring new logos (ACV growth) and expanding established enterprise accounts through direct and partner-led sales models.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-level technical and business stakeholders and translate technology into measurable business value.

  • Professional fluency in French and English with strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

Work Arrangement

The work arrangement for this role will be discussed with the hiring manager.

Pay Transparency

The OTE range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between €150,000 and €226,000 per year.

Please note that OTE offered may vary depending on relevant objective factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.
